dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Can solve multi-step problems
Begins to understand cause and effect
Can understand basic concepts of time and money
activities: Play board games that require strategy
watchFor: Difficulty following logical reasoning
Struggles with understanding basic math concepts
Shows disinterest in problem-solving tasks

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Can read simple books independently
Uses more complex sentences with proper grammar
Expands vocabulary with new words regularly
activities: Play word games like Scrabble or Boggle
watchFor: Difficulty expressing thoughts clearly
Limited vocabulary compared to peers
Struggles with reading comprehension

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Improves coordination in sports and physical activities
Can tie shoelaces and fasten buttons independently
Shows increased strength and endurance
activities: Enroll in a sports class or team
Encourage outdoor play like biking or hiking
Provide art supplies for crafts requiring fine motor skills
watchFor: Lacks coordination or is frequently clumsy
Avoids physical activities or sports
Difficulty with tasks requiring fine motor skills

dimensions.title: Social
milestones: Can form true friendships and maintain them
Understands and respects others' feelings
Can take turns and share more easily
activities: Engage in team sports or group activities
watchFor: Shows signs of social anxiety or isolation
Has difficulty making or keeping friends
Struggles with sharing or turn-taking

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Begins to understand and articulate feelings
Demonstrates resilience in the face of challenges
Can manage frustration with support
activities: Teach coping strategies for managing emotions
watchFor: Frequent emotional outbursts or meltdowns
Difficulty coping with disappointment
Shows signs of low self-esteem or confidence

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Shows interest in exploring new topics
Asks thoughtful questions related to their environment
Engages in hands-on activities and experimentation
activities: Provide kits for building or crafting
watchFor: Lack of interest in exploring or trying new things
Avoids asking questions about their surroundings
Shows no desire to discover or learn about the world

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on tasks for extended periods
Develops effective study habits
Shows curiosity about learning new things
activities: Establish a quiet, dedicated study space
watchFor: Easily distracted or unable to sustain attention
Avoids homework or learning activities
Struggles with organization and completing tasks

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can dress themselves and manage personal hygiene
Takes responsibility for their belongings
Begins to make simple decisions independently
watchFor: Shows reluctance to take on responsibilities
Needs constant reminders for personal tasks
Struggles to make choices or decisions
